patterns.note: A single-column, vertically expansive layout with generous spacing between content blocks, creating a narrative scroll experience without distinct section dividers.
Primary headings use a large, bold, rounded sans-serif font, creating a playful and approachable tone, contrasted with smaller, more conventional body text and a distinct monospaced logo.
A dark, almost black background serves as a high-contrast canvas for vibrant, multi-colored 3D elements and light, readable text.

Playful 3D clay-like objects (e.g., 'FUN' text, cloud, broken pieces) are integrated into the scroll, appearing to stay relatively fixed or parallax slowly against the scrolling 2D text content, creating a sense of depth.
Content is structured as a continuous narrative flow, with each 'section' introduced by a large heading, rather than using distinct background changes or hard visual breaks.

technique_notes: The site employs a full-bleed dark background that extends across the entire page. Headings are centered and given ample vertical padding to create a spacious, editorial feel.

The core visual effect involves integrating realistic 3D objects, such as the 'FUN' text and smaller clay shapes, into the page. These objects are rendered using a 3D library (likely Three.js, as indicated by 'webgl-three') and are positioned to appear as if they are floating or fixed in space, while the 2D text content scrolls over or around them, creating a dynamic depth effect as the user scrolls down the page. This motion is achieved by controlling the 3D scene's camera or object positions relative to the scroll position.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, rounded display headings (~3-4x body text) create a playful and impactful hierarchy, with standard body text and small monospaced accents.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded corners are subtly applied to content blocks and prominently used for form input fields, giving a soft and approachable character.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy vertical spacing between major content blocks and text lines, creating a relaxed and unhurried reading experience.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the playful integration of realistic, tactile 3D clay-like objects that interact with the scrolling text content. This creates a unique sense of depth and nostalgia, making the site feel handcrafted and memorable, rather than a generic digital experience.
